_doc: Task #551 §B / §E — registry of ACA Jobs that have been migrated to AWS Lambda + EventBridge. The CI guard `artifacts/syrabit-backend/scripts/check_dead_providers.py` walks `artifacts/syrabit-backend/aca_jobs/*.py` and fails the build for any module not represented here. Adding a new ACA Job without first landing its Lambda counterpart (handler + Terraform + EventBridge schedule) is a CI hard-fail.

migrated_jobs.schedule_doc: daily 01:00 UTC (ahead of materialize-chapter-faqs at 02:00 so warmed pages already have FAQ payloads)
migrated_jobs.notes: SEO prewarm engine (Spec §9 Tasks #574 + #575). Selects top-N chapters by 7-day analytics traffic UNION every chapter under a subject whose exam window starts within PREWARM_EXAM_LOOKAHEAD_DAYS, walks all 7 PAGE_TYPES per chapter, issues HEAD through Cloudflare so the worker fills its tiered cache, persists run summary to db.seo_prewarm_runs (consumed by /api/admin/seo/prewarm-coverage), and emits Syrabit/Cache::PrewarmSuccessRate to CloudWatch (alarm fires at <0.90).

migrated_jobs.schedule_doc: weekly Mondays 02:00 UTC (sits inside the daily cache-prewarm + FAQ-materialize window so measured pages are already warm)
migrated_jobs.notes: Weekly SEO baseline runner (Task #28). Wraps scripts/seo_baseline.py — Lighthouse + JSON-LD validator + Google Rich Results sampler over 20 chapter pages (4 boards × 5 chapters × notes page-type) — persists the full report to db.seo_baseline_runs (consumed by /api/admin/seo/baseline-latest), pre-computes the WoW median-SEO-score delta against the prior run, and emits Syrabit/SEO::{MedianSeoScore,PagesWithFailures,MedianSeoScoreWoWDelta} to CloudWatch. Two alarms ride on these metrics: seo-baseline-score-regression (WoW delta < -5) + seo-baseline-failures-high (>2 sampled pages with per-leg failures). Memory bumped to 1024 MB because Lighthouse + headless Chromium burns ~600 MB resident.

AEO Answer-Card + FAQ materializer. Walks every chapter, mines PYQ corpus + syllabus graph for 5-10 deterministic Q->A pairs and a 40-60-word Quick-Answer per chapter, renders via content_formatter.format_content(query_type='faq'/'quick_answer') and writes to db.chapter_faqs (authoritative) + db.aeo_faq_entries / db.aeo_quick_answers (renderer views consumed by routes/seo_pages.py) + Cloudflare KV / Redis under the Task #6 fingerprint key.

_task_87_doc: Task #87 / Task #47 — `aca_jobs/supabase_auth_canary.py` is the *prep* PR for the Supabase auth cutover. Its docstring explicitly defers Lambda + EventBridge wiring to the destructive cutover PR (so the JWKS infra can be reviewed without TF churn). Listed here so the canonical-delegation guard does not require a manifest entry until the destructive PR lands the matching `lambda_batch/supabase_auth_canary.py` handler + Terraform block in `artifacts/syrabit/infra/aws/lambda-batch-jobs.tf`. Remove this exemption when the cutover ships.
_task_571_doc: Task #571 — `cache-effectiveness` is a *new* batch shipper, not an ACA-Jobs migration; it has no `aca_module` counterpart. Listed in `auxiliary_jobs` below so the dead-providers CI guard (which only walks `aca_jobs/*.py`) does not require an entry, while the lambda-batch-jobs.tf locals.batch_jobs table still mirrors it 1:1.
_pending_shadow_policy: Jobs with cutover_status=pending_shadow are intentionally deferred until their shadow_end date is reached and at least one successful shadow execution has been verified in CloudWatch. The three jobs prewarm_seo_routes, seo_baseline, and materialize_chapter_faqs have shadow_end=2026-05-16. They MUST NOT be flipped to live before that date. Cutover is tracked in follow-up task #2.

auxiliary_jobs.name: chat-credit-runway
auxiliary_jobs.notes: Daily GCP credit-runway snapshot. Queries the GCP Billing BigQuery export, computes remaining_credits / (trailing_30d_burn / 30), writes the integer to Upstash Redis at chat:credit_runway_days (TTL 48h) so cost_caps._select_chat_primary's 60s cache picks it up on the next refresh. Publishes Syrabit/Cost::ChatCreditRunwayDays to CloudWatch; chat-credit-runway-stale alarm pages on-call when the metric is missing >24h.

auxiliary_jobs.name: chat-credit-runway-freshness
auxiliary_jobs.notes: Independent Sentry-backed >24h missing-runway alert. Reads chat:credit_runway_days from Upstash Redis directly (the publisher stamps a 48h TTL, so age = publish_ttl - remaining_pttl), and sentry_sdk.capture_message's when the value is missing or older than RUNWAY_FRESHNESS_THRESHOLD_S (default 24h). Hourly cadence × Sentry first-event dedup → on-call paged within ~1h of any publisher outage. Independence from the publisher matters: if the publisher Lambda fails to invoke, this probe is the only Sentry-side detector.

auxiliary_jobs.name: cache-effectiveness
auxiliary_jobs.notes: Daily shipper for the AI-input-cache snapshot. Scrapes admin-only /api/health/cache and emits per-content-type Hits/Misses/HitRatio/UniqueKeys24h/MissReason to the Syrabit/Cache CloudWatch namespace. Two alarms ride on the (ContentType=Total) dimension: cache-ai-hitratio-low (HitRatio < 0.30 for 1 day) + cache-cardinality-spike (UniqueKeys24h > 3x the trailing 7-day moving average).
